calibration.selection_rule: select 2000 iff mean resampled relative-LEW AUC_2000 <= 1.01*AUC_5000 and mean resampled Final_2000 <= 1.01*Final_5000; otherwise select 5000

classifications.factor_preference: favorable grand mean and favorable subject-mean sign in at least 2/3 development subjects; otherwise TIE or NULL
classifications.overfitting: SEVERE if mean overfit gap >=50 percentage points; REDUCED if >5; ABSENT if <=5
classifications.quality_equivalent: mean fixed relative-LEW AUC <=1.01*mean paired resampled AUC and mean fixed final LEW <=1.02*mean paired resampled final LEW
classifications.wall_clock_advantage: on aggregate mean evaluation curves, fixed reaches the paired resampled epoch-500 mean LEW and has lower mean cumulative optimization wall-clock at first reach

controls.BNCI_eta_norm_rule: median initial raw uniform-SPDSW update norm under LR=3000, subjects 1,3,8, seed 6398, resampled uniform N_proj=500
controls.HGD_eta_norm_source: results/coherent_sw_overnight/SCALE_MATCHED_CONFIG.json: frozen audited direct-SPDSW dataset-specific normalized step

heldout_gate: fixed uniform or fixed spectral is development quality-equivalent
no post-hoc N_proj or sigma change
actual aggregate matched-quality wall-clock benefit exists
